name: Arkansas Glass Container Corporation
description: Arkansas Glass Container Corporation, located in Jonesboro, Arkansas, has been on the same property since 1948. Originally built to produce minnow-roach bait traps, a change in ownership and the company name in the mid-1950s resulted in a shift to food-grade containers -- a product that we still produce today. Proud to be American owned, Arkansas Glass Container Corporation, makes glass containers ranging from 8 ounces to one-gallon. We also offer a family of patented designed containers called the Stout, used for sauces, beverages or dressings.
